cards.back: early period / initial stage (the beginning phase of a dynasty or era)
cards.example: 清朝初期的一百多年，国家稳定，社会繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the first hundred-plus years of the Qing Dynasty, the country was stable and society prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 初：用刀（刀）裁布（衣），第一次开始做的事 · 期：每月（月）的特定时间（其），一段时期

cards.back: stable / steady (not changing or shaking — used for countries, prices, moods)
cards.example: 清朝初期国家稳定，社会繁荣。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the early Qing, the country was stable and society prosperous.
cards.breakdown: 稳：禾苗（禾）在急流中站稳（急），不倒不摇 · 定：屋顶（宀）下一切安定（正），不再变动

cards.back: prosperous / flourishing (economy booming, society thriving) ★复习L8
cards.example: 清朝初期社会繁荣，疆域达到1,200万平方千米。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the early Qing, society flourished and the territory reached 12 million square kilometers.
cards.breakdown: 繁：枝繁叶茂的大树，丝线（糸）纷纷交织 · 荣：草木（艹）在房屋（冖）上茂盛生长，兴旺辉煌

cards.back: to sail / to navigate / voyage (traveling by sea or air)
cards.example: 欧洲人通过远洋航行开辟了海外市场。
cards.exampleTranslation: Europeans opened up overseas markets through ocean voyages.
cards.breakdown: 航：船（舟）沿着方向（亢）行驶 · 行：十字路口，人走路

cards.back: to open up / to create (a new path, market, or territory where none existed)
cards.example: 欧洲人通过远洋航行开辟了海外市场。
cards.exampleTranslation: Europeans opened up overseas markets through ocean voyages.
cards.breakdown: 开：两只手（廾）移开门栓（一），打开大门 · 辟：用力（辛）把门（口）打开，开创新路

cards.back: market / marketplace (a place or system for buying and selling goods)
cards.example: 欧洲人开辟了海外市场，商业经济取代了农业经济。
cards.exampleTranslation: Europeans opened overseas markets; the commercial economy replaced the agricultural economy.
cards.breakdown: 市：人们聚在一起买卖东西的地方 · 场：太阳（日）照着的土地（土），宽阔的场所

cards.back: economy / economic (the system of producing, trading, and consuming goods)
cards.example: 商业经济取代了农业经济。
cards.exampleTranslation: The commercial economy replaced the agricultural economy.
cards.breakdown: 经：丝线（纟）编织的经线，表示经常、经营 · 济：水（氵）流过去，渡过难关，帮助发展

cards.back: trade / commerce (buying and selling between countries or regions)
cards.example: 18世纪末，在中英贸易中，英国一直有很大的逆差。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late 18th century, Britain consistently had a large deficit in Sino-British trade.
cards.breakdown: 贸：用商品（卯）交换钱财（贝）· 易：蜥蜴变色，表示交换、改变

cards.back: trend / current / tide (a direction of change in society or the world)
cards.example: 闭关自守、盲目自大，使中国落后于世界的先进潮流。
cards.exampleTranslation: Isolationism and blind arrogance caused China to fall behind the world's advanced trends.
cards.breakdown: 潮：水（氵）随着早晨（朝）的月亮涨落，是潮水 · 流：水（氵）不停地流动，传播开去

cards.back: every year / each year / annually
cards.example: 每年有四万多箱鸦片卖到中国。
cards.exampleTranslation: Over 40,000 chests of opium were sold to China each year.
cards.breakdown: 每：像母亲（母）一样，每一个都不落下 · 年：庄稼成熟的一个周期，一年

cards.back: unexpectedly / to one's surprise (expressing shock or disbelief at something outrageous)
cards.example: 英国居然冒天下之大不韪，开始了罪恶的鸦片贸易。
cards.exampleTranslation: Britain actually had the audacity to defy all morality and began the evil opium trade.
cards.breakdown: 居：屋子（尸）里的人安居下来，本来安稳 · 然：像火（灬）烤肉（月），竟然，表示出乎意料

cards.pinyin: mào tiān xià zhī dà bù wěi
cards.back: to risk universal condemnation / to defy all morality (doing something so outrageous that the whole world condemns it)
cards.example: 英国居然冒天下之大不韪，开始了鸦片贸易。
cards.exampleTranslation: Britain had the audacity to defy all morality and started the opium trade.
cards.breakdown: 冒：遮住眼睛（目）往上闯，不顾危险 · 天下：全天下的人 · 之：的 · 大不韪：极大的错误（韪 = 对的，不韪 = 不对的）

cards.back: chest / box / crate (a container; here a measure word for opium shipments)
cards.example: 到了1838年，每年有四万多箱鸦片卖到中国。
cards.exampleTranslation: By 1838, over 40,000 chests of opium were sold to China each year.
cards.breakdown: 箱：竹子（竹）做的容器，用来装东西（相）

cards.back: to suffer deeply from something / to be seriously harmed by it
cards.example: 鸦片贸易不但使老百姓深受其害，而且白银大量外流。
cards.exampleTranslation: The opium trade not only deeply harmed the common people, but also caused a massive outflow of silver.
cards.breakdown: 深：水（氵）很深，程度很大 · 受：接受、承受 · 其：代词，指那个东西 · 害：屋顶（宀）下带来伤害

cards.back: moreover / and also / furthermore (adding another point, often with 不但…而且…)
cards.example: 不但老百姓深受其害，而且白银大量外流。
cards.exampleTranslation: Not only did the common people suffer deeply, but moreover silver flowed out in great quantities.
cards.breakdown: 而：像下巴上的胡须，表示转折或递进 · 且：像砖头一层层往上叠，表示还有更多

cards.back: all / entire / completely (every single bit, nothing left out)
cards.example: 林则徐在虎门将收来的鸦片全部销毁。
cards.exampleTranslation: Lin Zexu completely destroyed all the collected opium at Humen.
cards.breakdown: 全：屋顶下（入）有宝玉（玉），完整无缺 · 部：划分区域，每个部分（阝 + 咅）

cards.back: to invade / invasion (armed forces entering another country's territory)
cards.example: 1840年，英国派军舰入侵中国广州和浙江。
cards.exampleTranslation: In 1840, Britain sent warships to invade Guangzhou and Zhejiang.
cards.breakdown: 入：像箭头插入，进入内部 · 侵：人（亻）手持扫帚闯入，侵犯领地

cards.back: with all one's might / to fight hard (giving everything you have)
cards.example: 清军奋力抵抗，但最终战败。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Qing army fought with all its might but ultimately lost.
cards.breakdown: 奋：大鸟振翅高飞（大 + 田），拼尽全力 · 力：像一只伸出的手臂，表示力量

cards.back: to be forced / to be compelled (having no choice — done against one's will)
cards.example: 清政府被迫同英国签订了《南京条约》。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Qing government was forced to sign the Treaty of Nanjing with Britain.
cards.breakdown: 被：衣服（衤）覆盖在身上，被动承受 · 迫：在路上（辶）被人追赶（白），不得不做

cards.back: to stipulate / regulation / rule (an official requirement written in law or treaty)
cards.example: 条约规定中国向英国赔款2,100万银圆。
cards.exampleTranslation: The treaty stipulated that China pay Britain an indemnity of 21 million silver dollars.
cards.breakdown: 规：用圆规画圆（夫），定出规矩（见）· 定：屋顶（宀）下安定（正），做出确定不变的决定

cards.back: Hong Kong — island ceded to Britain by the Treaty of Nanjing in 1842; its New Territories were later leased as well
cards.example: 《南京条约》规定中国割让香港岛给英国。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Treaty of Nanjing stipulated that China cede Hong Kong Island to Britain.

cards.back: port / trade port (a city or harbor opened for foreign trade)
cards.example: 《南京条约》规定中国开放五个通商口岸。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Treaty of Nanjing stipulated that China open five ports to foreign trade.
cards.breakdown: 口：嘴巴，这里指河流入海口 · 岸：山（山）边水的尽头（厂），河岸、海岸

cards.back: jurisdiction / judicial authority (here: extraterritoriality — a foreign power's right to judge its own citizens on Chinese soil)
cards.example: 《南京条约》规定英国单方面拥有领事裁判权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Treaty of Nanjing granted Britain unilateral consular jurisdiction.
cards.breakdown: 裁：用衣（衣）料裁剪（戈），引申为裁决 · 判：用刀（刂）把东西分开（半），判断是非 · 权：树木（木）的重要枝干（雚），引申为权力
